title: muND extraction input
description: extraction/<task>/input-A.json and input-B.json: one of the two independent extractions of the values of a source (docs/extraction.ja.md). A submitted input is not changed any more. The order of the properties below is the canonical key order of the file.

slot.description: Which of the two inputs this is; equal to the file name.

mode.description: human: typed by a person from the source. ai: written by an AI model from the source alone. assisted: an AI draft corrected by a person (the draft is kept in aiDraft).

extractor.description: human and assisted: the person who extracted (or corrected) the values.

sourceSha256.description: SHA-256 of the PDF this input was made from; equal to source.sha256 of the task.

run.description: ai only: the run that wrote this input.

aiDraft.description: assisted only: the AI draft as the AI wrote it, kept unchanged.

coverage.description: For every table / figure / passage of the source: whether it was read and holds values (covered) or holds no relevant data (no-data). needs-check: could not be decided.

rows.description: The values found, one per row.

submitted.description: Present once the input is submitted; it is not changed afterwards.

model.description: The model that produced the answer, as the API reported it.

requestedModel.description: The model that was asked (differs from model when the request was handed to a fallback model).

promptVersion.description: Version of the instructions and the output format given to the model (tools/mundlib/extraction_ai.py).

requestId.description: Request id reported by the API.

item.description: label of a source item of the task (or of one this input found in addition).

number.description: A number written with the digits given in the source.

row.description: One value as found in the source.

id.description: Identifies the row within this input (referred to by the adjudication).

mass.description: Mass number A; 0 = natural isotopic abundance.

conditions.description: Short label of the measurement conditions that distinguish values of the same nuclide and quantity (target form ...). Rows are matched by it; it becomes the key of the published entry.

original.description: The notation as printed in the source: only the number, the unit and the uncertainty, no sentences.

unit.description: ASCII unit as in the data files (us = microsecond).

uncertainties.description: As in the data files: one standard deviation, in the unit of the value; empty when the source gives none.

needsCheck.description: 要確認: what could not be read with certainty. What cannot be read is left out (nuclide, value, unit), not guessed.

notes.description: Notes of the extractor (short, own words).

item.description: Table, figure or passage (label of a source item of the task).

label.description: Row, column or label within the item.
